name: GitHub Enterprise Governance
description: Skills for provisioning and maintaining the GitHub Enterprise governance framework — repo/team factory, compliance sync, waiver dashboard, admin reports, and audit log queries.

skills.name: governance-setup
skills.description: Full one-time governance framework setup (10 steps). Provisions governance repo, waiver system, compliance workflows, factory workflows, audit reporting, rulesets, labels, and base teams.

skills.name: governance-new-repo
skills.description: Interactive 10-step wizard to request a new repository. Validates name, collects metadata, generates YAML, and opens a governance PR for admin approval.

skills.name: governance-new-team
skills.description: Interactive wizard to create or update a GitHub team via the governance PR process. Collects slug, visibility, parent, maintainers, and members.

skills.name: governance-sync-compliance
skills.description: Push the canonical compliance.yml template to all non-archived repos in the org. Supports dry-run and single-repo mode.

skills.name: governance-admin-report
skills.description: Read-only report: current org owners, repos with direct admin collaborators, teams with admin permission, platform-admins members, recent admin changes.

skills.name: governance-waiver-status

flags.--all: Include recently expired and rejected waivers
flags.--repo <name>: Filter results to a specific repository

skills.description: Colour-coded waiver dashboard: pending approvals, active waivers with expiry countdowns, waivers expiring in the next 7 days.

skills.name: governance-audit-query
skills.description: Interactive 10-item audit log query menu. Covers admin changes, ruleset bypasses, repo creation, secrets, webhooks, dismissed alerts, app installs, team changes, settings. CSV export available.
